issue.title: Truth-up AGENT_ONBOARDING: recording is wired; fix Jest suite count
issue.body:
### Problem statement

`docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` still describes recording as largely stubbed and persistence to `recordings` as not fully wired. That is false on current `main` after #49 / #94–#98 / #100 and related work.

It also claims Jest has “18 suites”; the repo now has on the order of ~75 `*.test.ts(x)` files.

Stale onboarding misleads new developers and agents about where to start.

### Scope

- Update the product blurb in `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md` so it matches current Record / recordings / upload state (high level; do not invent unfinished AC).
- Fix the Jest suite count (or replace with a non-brittle phrasing such as “Jest + Testing Library; see `src/**/*.test.*`”).
- Quick pass for any other obviously false “stubbed” claims in that file only.

### Out of scope

- Rewriting all of `docs/` or architecture diagrams unless required for accuracy.
- Implementing product features.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Onboarding no longer says recording UI / `recordings` persistence is stubbed/unwired when that is false on `main`.
- [ ] Test count / test guidance is accurate or intentionally non-numeric.
- [ ] A new reader can tell Record + upload exist and which follow-ups remain (e.g. #235 source dock, #253 SyncScreen glue, #71 multi-take UI).

### Verification

- [ ] Diff reviewed against `origin/main` Record / `recordingsRepository` / upload paths.
- [ ] `npm test -- --ci` not required for docs-only unless touched scripts.

### Priority

P2 — onboarding hygiene for the incoming developer.

### File pointers

- `docs/AGENT_ONBOARDING.md`
- Related (read-only context): `src/app/tabs/RecordTab.tsx`, `src/db/recordingsRepository.ts`, `src/services/recordingSync.ts`

### Follow up with fluent-api team
When you pick this up, please ask the fluent-api team:
1. Is the needed feature planned / in progress?
2. Expected ETA (or “not scheduled”)?
3. Is there already an open fluent-api GitHub issue or PR? If yes, link it here; if no, ask them to file one (or file it yourself and link it).
